about.title: About Yingshibao
about.subtitle: Changdong Medical — Exclusive Distributor for Indonesia
about.intro: Yingshibao (Zhengzhou Yingshibao Trading Co., Ltd.) is the authorized exclusive distributor of Changdong (Evereast) Medical Co., Ltd. for the Indonesian market. We are based in Zhengzhou, Henan — China's medical device manufacturing hub — and are fully focused on bringing Changdong's premium medical products to Indonesian healthcare providers.

changdong.title: About Changdong Medical
changdong.text: Changdong (Evereast) Medical Co., Ltd. is a leading Chinese medical device manufacturer with a 150,000m² facility in Changyuan, Henan. Founded in 2004, Changdong holds ISO13485, CE MDR (SGS), and FDA certifications. Their products are exported to 60+ countries including the UK (NHS approved), the EU, and the Middle East. Changdong is listed on the Chinese Ministry of Commerce export white list (#51).

advantage.title: Our Advantage
advantage.text: As the exclusive distributor for Indonesia, we offer direct factory pricing, full regulatory support (NIE registration, IDAK, CDAKB), and seamless communication in English, Chinese, and Bahasa Indonesia. Our product range covers 38+ categories with CE MDR certification — a true blue ocean in the Indonesian market.

about.exclusive_note: We are the authorized exclusive distributor of Changdong Medical for Indonesia. We represent the factory, not a middleman.
